The whole file's tags
DNGVersion 1.4, UniqueCameraModel
ColorMatrix1 + D65, AsShotNeutral
BaselineExposure ..., Orientation

SubIFD 0: the raw image
CFA: the whole frame, ActiveArea
or LinearRaw, 16 bits
256x256 tiles, lossless JPEG
BlackLevel, WhiteLevel, DefaultCrop
